abstract: In a 15 year retrospective study of ovarian tumours, in Medical College, Amristsar, 636 cases were reviewed. Serous tumours were the commonest with 208 cases followed by mucinous tumours which formed the 2nd commonest group with 159 cases and teratoma which formed the 3rd commonest group with 142 cases. Of 636 tumours, 420 were benign, 201 malignant and 15 of borderline malignancy.
abstract_ja: インド・パンジャブ州アムリツサルの医科大学における15年間の後方視的研究で、卵巣腫瘍636例を検討した。漿液性腫瘍が208例で最も多く、次いで粘液性腫瘍159例、奇形腫が142例で3番目に多かった。636例の腫瘍のうち、420例が良性、201例が悪性、15例が境界悪性であった。
